title: Total-fraction membership detected in codimension at most one for S2 rings
statement: Let $R$ be a reduced Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] satisfying $(S_2)$ [def-weil-pbc-serre-conditions-rk-sk]. Let $x\in Q(R)$, the localization at its nonzerodivisors [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Suppose for every prime $p$ of height at most one [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] there exist $s\notin p$ and $a\in R$ with $sx=a$ in $Q(R)$. Then $x$ belongs to the image of $R\to Q(R)$. Reduced means that no nonzero element is nilpotent.

proof.text: Write x=a/b with b regular. If a belongs to bR, cancel the unit b in Q(R) to express x as an element of R. Otherwise its class in R/bR is nonzero. Noetherian associated-prime existence gives an associated prime p containing its annihilator J.
The regular quotient associated-height lemma gives height(p)≤1. Choose s outside p and c with sx=c. Multiply by b and use injectivity R→Q(R) to obtain sa=cb, hence s belongs to J⊆p, a contradiction.
